idioms.errors: Return a result value (a tagged success or error object) from a function that can fail; raise only in an edge file.
idioms.immutability: Use tuples, frozen dataclasses and copies (dict(x), [*x]) instead of changing an argument in place.
idioms.routing: A dispatch table (dict of handlers) or structural pattern matching instead of if/elif chains.
idioms.purity: Pure functions in domain code; pass I/O in as arguments.

regex_rules.message: raise outside an edge file; return a result value
mutable default argument is shared between calls
